Key.English: Player: Block PiR Damage Until Plates Break

Key.Original: Human-controlled units only. This is not the same as plate absorption alone: APS always reduces hits through plate math. When this is ON, PiR-compatible code also forces residual PiR injury on protected hits to zero while plates remain, and coordinates HitPart so you can optionally allow reactions below. The hit that destroys the last plate may still pass overflow damage. For AI, turn on AI: Use Custom PiR Plate Rules first, then use the AI block option.
Key.English: Human-controlled units only. This is not the same as plate absorption alone: APS always reduces hits through plate math. When this is ON, PiR-compatible code also forces residual PiR injury on protected hits to zero while plates remain, and coordinates HitPart so you can optionally allow reactions below. The hit that destroys the last plate may still pass overflow damage. For AI, turn on AI: Use Custom PiR Plate Rules first, then use the AI block option.

Key.Original: Human-controlled units only. Only applies when Player: Block PiR Damage Until Plates Break is ON. On absorbed torso hits while plates remain, still play PiR hit reactions (PiRanim) instead of staying silent until the last plate breaks.
Key.English: Human-controlled units only. Only applies when Player: Block PiR Damage Until Plates Break is ON. On absorbed torso hits while plates remain, still play PiR hit reactions (PiRanim) instead of staying silent until the last plate breaks.

Key.Original: AI: Use Custom PiR Plate Rules
Key.English: AI: Use Custom PiR Plate Rules

Key.Original: OFF (default): AI do not use the PiR HitPart compatibility bridge; plate mitigation still runs in HandleDamage, and PiR reactions behave like APS + PiR without these AI toggles (typically little or no reaction until plates are gone). ON: the two AI options below apply so you can match player-style blocking and optional reactions while plates hold.
Key.English: OFF (default): AI do not use the PiR HitPart compatibility bridge; plate mitigation still runs in HandleDamage, and PiR reactions behave like APS + PiR without these AI toggles (typically little or no reaction until plates are gone). ON: the two AI options below apply so you can match player-style blocking and optional reactions while plates hold.

Key.Original: Only when AI: Use Custom PiR Plate Rules is ON. Same strict PiR gate as the player option (not duplicate of normal plate absorption). With block ON and Allow reactions OFF, AI stay quiet on absorbed vest hits until plates fail; with Allow ON, they can play PiRanim on those hits.
Key.English: Only when AI: Use Custom PiR Plate Rules is ON. Same strict PiR gate as the player option (not duplicate of normal plate absorption). With block ON and Allow reactions OFF, AI stay quiet on absorbed vest hits until plates fail; with Allow ON, they can play PiRanim on those hits.
